current_text: Make sharp the arrows; hold firm the shields: YHWH has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes; because his purpose is against Bavel, to destroy it: for it is the vengeance of YHWH, the vengeance of his temple.

previous_verse: The portion of Ya'akov is not like these; for YHWH is the former of all things; and [Israel] is the tribe of YHWH’s inheritance: YHWH of Armies is the name.
next_verse: and with you will I break in pieces the horse and his rider;

next_verse: The violence done to me and to my flesh be on Bavel, shall the inhabitant of Tzion say; and, My blood be on the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Yerushalayim say.

previous_verse: for the destroyer is come on her, even on Bavel, and her mighty people are taken, their bows are broken in pieces; for YHWH is a God of recompenses, YHWH will surely requite.
next_verse: Thus says YHWH of Armies: The broad walls of Bavel shall be utterly overthrown, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the peoples shall labor for vanity, and the nations for the fire; and they shall be weary.

current_text: YHWH has swallowed up all the habitations of Ya'akov, and has not pitied: He has thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Yehudah; He has brought them down to the ground; he has profaned the kingdom and the princes of it.
previous_verse: How has YHWH covered the daughter of Tzion with a cloud in YHWH’s anger! YHWH has cast down from heaven to the earth the beauty of Israel, And hasn't remembered YHWH’s footstool in the day of YHWH’s anger.
next_verse: YHWH has cut off in fierce anger all the horn of Israel; YHWH has drawn back YHWH’s right hand from before the enemy: YHWH has burned up Ya'akov like a flaming fire, which devours round about.

current_text: YHWH has violently taken away YHWH’s tent, as if it were of a garden; YHWH has destroyed YHWH’s place of assembly: YHWH has caused solemn assembly and Sabbath to be forgotten in Tzion, Has despised in the indignation of YHWH’s anger the king and the priest.
previous_verse: YHWH is become as an enemy, YHWH has swallowed up Israel; YHWH has swallowed up all her palaces, YHWH has destroyed his strongholds; YHWH has multiplied in the daughter of Yehudah mourning and lamentation.
next_verse: YHWH has cast off YHWH’s altar, YHWH has abhorred YHWH’s sanctuary; YHWH has given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces: They have made a noise in the house of YHWH, as in the day of a solemn assembly.

current_text: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he has destroyed and broken her bars: Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not; Yes, her prophets find no vision from YHWH.
previous_verse: YHWH has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Tzion; He has stretched out the line, he has not withdrawn his hand from destroying; He has made the rampart and wall to lament; they languish together.
next_verse: The elders of the daughter of Tzion sit on the ground, they keep silence; They have cast up dust on their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: The virgins of Yerushalayim hang down their heads to the ground.

current_text: The kings of the earth didn't believe, neither all the inhabitants of the world, That the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Yerushalayim.
previous_verse: YHWH has accomplished YHWH’s wrath, YHWH has poured out YHWH’s fierce anger; YHWH has kindled a fire in Tzion, which has devoured the foundations of it.
next_verse: [It is] because of the sins of her prophets, [and] the iniquities of her priests, That have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her.

current_text: In the fifth [day] of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,
previous_verse: Now it happened in the thirtieth year, in the fourth [month], in the fifth [day] of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of Elohim.
next_verse: the word of YHWH came expressly to Yechezkel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of YHWH was there on him.

current_text: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments will I judge them; and they shall know that I am YHWH.
previous_verse: Mischief shall come on mischief, and rumor shall be on rumor; and they shall seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

previous_verse: Moreover the word of YHWH came to me, saying,
next_verse: and he took of the seed royal, and made a covenant with him; he also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land;

current_text: that the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.
previous_verse: and he took of the seed royal, and made a covenant with him; he also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land;
next_verse: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Mitzrayim, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape who does such things? shall he break the covenant, and yet escape?

current_text: As I live, says YHWH God, surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the midst of Bavel he shall die.
previous_verse: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Mitzrayim, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape who does such things? shall he break the covenant, and yet escape?
next_verse: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts, to cut off many persons.

current_text: They put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Bavel; they brought him into strongholds, that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.
previous_verse: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces; and they spread their net over him; he was taken in their pit.
next_verse: Your mother was like a vine, in your blood, planted by the waters: it was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

current_text: As I live, says YHWH God, surely with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, will I be king over you:
previous_verse: and that which comes into your mind shall not be at all, in that you say, We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
next_verse: and I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries in which you are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out;

current_text: Also, you child of humanity, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Bavel may come; they both shall come forth out of one land: and mark out a place, mark it out at the head of the way to the city.
previous_verse: The word of YHWH came to me again, saying,
next_verse: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Yehudah in Yerushalayim the fortified.

current_text: For the king of Bavel stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he shook the arrows back and forth, he consulted the teraphim, he looked in the liver.
previous_verse: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Yehudah in Yerushalayim the fortified.
next_verse: In his right hand was the divination [for] Yerushalayim, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, to build forts.

current_text: Child of humanity, write you the name of the day, [even] of this same day: the king of Bavel drew close to Yerushalayim this same day.
previous_verse: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth [day] of the month, the word of YHWH came to me, saying,

current_text: For thus says YHWH God: Behold, I will bring on Tzor Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel, king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and a company, and much people.
previous_verse: Her daughters who are in the field shall be slain with the sword: and they shall know that I am YHWH.
next_verse: He shall kill with the sword your daughters in the field; and he shall make forts against you, and cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.

next_verse: In the time that you were broken by the seas in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company did fall in the midst of you.

previous_verse: In the time that you were broken by the seas in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company did fall in the midst of you.
next_verse: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you; you are become a terror, and you shall nevermore have any being.

current_text: Child of humanity, take up a lamentation over the king of Tzor, and tell him, Thus says YHWH God: You seal up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
previous_verse: Moreover the word of YHWH came to me, saying,
next_verse: You were in Eden, the garden of Elohim; every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and beryl. Gold work of tambourines and of pipes was in you. In the day that you were created they were prepared.

current_text: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty; you have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your brightness: I have cast you to the ground; I have laid you before kings, that they may see you.
previous_verse: By the abundance of your traffic they filled the midst of you with violence, and you have sinned: therefore I have cast you as profane out of the mountain of Elohim; and I have destroyed you, covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
next_verse: By the multitude of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your traffic, you have profaned your sanctuaries; therefore have I brought forth a fire from the midst of you; it has devoured you, and I have turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all those who see you.
